THE ULTIMATE DOWNTOWN WATER EXPERIENCE

Witness the Dubai Fountain Show from the Heart of Burj Lake

Standing on the crowded boardwalks of the Dubai Mall or the Souk Al Bahar bridge offers only a distant glimpse of the world's most spectacular choreographed water show. The Burj Khalifa Lake Ride transforms this iconic performance into an intimate, sensory encounter. Step aboard an authentic Arabian wooden Abra boat and glide across the crystal-clear, 30-acre Burj Lake while 6,600 superlights and 25 color projectors illuminate water jets soaring up to 500 feet into the air.

Synchronized to classical compositions, contemporary international hits, and sweeping Arabic melodies like Andrea Bocelli's Time to Say Goodbye, the show envelops your boat in sound and mist. With the towering 828-meter Burj Khalifa rising directly above your vessel, this is undeniably the most photogenic and romantic vantage point in all of Dubai.

Experience Highlights

  • 30-Minute Abra Cruise: Relax on the serene Burj Lake away from pedestrian crowds.
  • Front-Row Fountain Views: Sail within meters of the powerful synchronized water cannons.
  • Photographer's Dream: Capture Burj Khalifa from base to spire without crowd obstruction.
  • Authentic Wooden Abra: Cruise smoothly on a traditional heritage motorized boat operated by licensed captains.

Dubai Fountain Show Timings & Best Visiting Hours

The Dubai Fountain operates every evening from 18:00 to 23:00 with performances commencing every 30 minutes. The lake ride departs continuously between 17:45 and 23:15.

Sunset Show 17:45 – 18:30

Golden hour skies reflecting on Burj Lake

Prime Evening 19:00 – 21:30

Full night illumination & LED tower projection

Late Night 22:00 – 23:15

Calmer atmosphere with romantic skyline lights

How to Reach the Boarding Point

The Abra boarding dock is conveniently located on the Dubai Mall Waterfront Promenade, directly facing the Burj Khalifa and adjacent to the Souk Al Bahar bridge.

  • By Metro: Take the Red Line to Burj Khalifa / Dubai Mall Metro Station, then take the air-conditioned link bridge directly into the mall. Head to the Ground Floor Waterfront Promenade exit.
  • By Taxi: Ask your driver for the Dubai Mall Fashion Avenue or Cinema Parking drop-off, then walk down to the lake boardwalk.
  • Private Transfers: Ask Phoenix Tours about our private hotel pickup and drop-off packages across Dubai and Sharjah.

Frequently Asked Questions

Will I get wet during the fountain show on the boat?

The Abra maintains a secure buffer perimeter from the high-pressure water shooters. You may feel a refreshing fine mist when the water cannons reach their full 500-foot height, but guests do not get soaked.

Is the lake ride suitable for young children and seniors?

Yes! The water on Burj Lake is smooth, calm, and current-free. Safe boarding ramps and life vests are provided for guests of all ages, making it comfortable for toddlers, families, and elderly grandparents.

Can I take photos and videos during the ride?

Absolutely. Phones and DSLRs are fully welcomed. Because you are on the water, you get complete panoramic frames of the fountain with the entire height of the Burj Khalifa in the background without heads blocking your view.

How do I combine this with a desert safari or city tour?

You can easily pair this experience with our Dubai City Tour or a morning Dubai Desert Safari. Contact our team on WhatsApp and we will structure an all-inclusive daily itinerary for your group.
